objectives.title: Processing Restriction Measures
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding mechanisms or procedures to restrict data processing operations upon the data subject's request.
criteria: Mechanisms enabling data processing suspension upon data accuracy challenges.
Provisions restricting data processing when erasure is contested.
Procedures preserving data needed exclusively for legal claims.
Mechanisms freezing processing activities pending objection assessments.

objectives.title: Management of Restricted Data
objectives.description: The contract contains writings defining permissible processing actions during an active restriction.
criteria: Limitation of restricted personal data activities to storage exclusively.
Requirement of the data subject's consent for active processing during restrictions.
Allowance of restricted data processing strictly for legal claims defense.
Allowance of restricted data processing for third-party protection.
Allowance of restricted data processing for public interest grounds.

objectives.title: Notification of Restriction Removal
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding communication preceding the lifting of processing restrictions.
criteria: Requirements for prior notification before lifting processing restrictions.
Specified timelines for notifying the customer before restriction removal.
